resources.string: Every tape is different. Start gently and compare with the original while the music keeps playing.
Live tone controls off or bypassed
Live tone controls on for original audio
Saved enhanced version playing · live tone controls bypassed
Rumble reduces very low bass. Clarity also gently reduces low-mid buildup, without boosting treble or tape hiss.

Live tone controls apply to original audio on this device, including downloads. Saved enhanced versions use their own processing. Cast receivers use original audio.\n\nThese live controls provide gentle tone correction. They cannot recover detail lost to distortion or reliably remove the crowd. Compare at a comfortable volume; louder is not always better.
Mix the processed audio with the original recording.
